description: Source code for a firmware image builder/viewer/extractor utility for Poray firmware files, including functions for reading, writing, inspecting, and obfuscating firmware images, with support for different hardware IDs and flash layouts.

methods.name: find_board
methods.description: Finds a board info structure by its name.

methods.name: find_board_by_hwid
methods.description: Finds a board info structure by hardware ID.

methods.name: find_layout
methods.description: Finds a flash layout by its ID.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line tool.

methods.name: read_to_buf
methods.description: Reads file contents into a buffer.

methods.name: check_options
methods.description: Validates command-line options and file parameters.

methods.name: fill_header
methods.description: Fills firmware header with hardware ID, firmware length, and flags.

methods.name: xor_fw
methods.description: Obfuscates or de-obfuscates firmware data using XOR with a key.

methods.name: write_fw
methods.description: Writes firmware data to output file.

methods.name: build_fw
methods.description: Builds firmware image file with header, checksum, and obfuscation.

methods.name: inspect_fw
methods.description: Inspects firmware file, verifies checksum, and optionally extracts firmware.
